enchants.Telepathy: When breaking a block or killing a mob, the dropped item will go directly into your inventory.
enchants.Sift I: Has a chance to change lab purity blocks into other purity blocks, and drop purity items. (Sand, Gravel & Dirt)
enchants.Plow II: Sneak and right-click on dirt to plow all dirt in a 5x5 square
enchants.Haste I: While holding the tool, you will have permanent Haste I
enchants.Haste II: While holding the tool, you will have permanent Haste II
enchants.Auto smelt: Any smeltable blocks broken with the tool will be smelted when dropped
enchants.Speed I: While wearing, grants permanent Speed I
enchants.Speed II: While wearing, grants permanent Speed II
enchants.Nourishing: When consumed, grants Invisibility, Jump Boost IV, and a few seconds of Speed III followed by Speed II
enchants.Bottomless: Item can be used repeatedly, on a cooldown
enchants.Low Gravity III: While wearing, grants permanent Jump Boost III
enchants.Aquatic: While wearing, grants permanent Water Breathing
enchants.Night Vision: While wearing, grants permanent Night Vision
enchants.Unbreakable: The item will never lose durability
enchants.Extra Large: The potion can be consumed more than once
enchants.Self-Detonate: While wearing, sneak to ignite, and blow yourself up after four seconds, killing you and dealing damage to nearby players
enchants.Chum: When used (right-click), doubles all fish caught for the next 20 minutes. Time stacks if another is used while one is active
enchants.Drippy: Creates drippy water particle effects around the wearer
enchants.Aqua Launch: While wearing, sneak to launch in the direction you're facing. The launch is much more powerful when standing in water/lava or on ice
enchants.Soulbound I: 50% base* chance to keep the item on death Chance decreases if your killer is using a Materializer (Materialize enchantment)
enchants.Soulbound II: 100% base* chance to keep the item on death Chance decreases if your killer is using a Materializer (Materialize enchantment)
enchants.Soulbound III: The item will never drop on death
enchants.Flex: While wearing, sneak to flex, granting yourself and nearby players Strength II and Resistance for a few seconds
enchants.Blinding: When hitting a player with this item, there's a small chance that they will receive Blindness for a few seconds
enchants.Soggy: Moist sounds and wet particle effects are created when hitting something with this item
enchants.Slowfall: While holding this item, you will receive Slow Falling
enchants.Sand Excavate: Has a chance to destroy sand in a 3x3x2 area around the block broken
enchants.Catalyze: Instantly converts sugarcane to sugar or paper, melon slices to melon seeds, and pumpkins to pumpkin seeds. Has a charge level that must be sustained by farming while holding the item in your hand or offhand. The lower the charge, the less efficient the conversion is
enchants.Dash: While wearing, sneak to dash forward, on a cooldown
enchants.Molten Tackle: Any cod and salmon caught with this rod will be cooked instantly
enchants.Conjure: Increases the chances of a mini-boss spawning when you kill a mob in The Pit while using this weapon
enchants.Herbalist I: Right-click to plant ground crops (soulsand- or soil-based) in a 3x3 area around the right-clicked block, using seeds from your inventory
enchants.Herbalist II: Plants in a 5x5 area, and can similarly plant cocoa beans in a 5x5 area on jungle logs
enchants.Speed Surge III: While wearing, sneak to get a few seconds of Speed III, on a cooldown
enchants.Amorphous I: While holding this tool, press your swap hand key (default F) to transform the tool type between an Axe and a Hoe
enchants.Amorphous II: While holding this tool, press your swap hand key (default F) to transform the tool type between an Axe, Hoe, Pickaxe and Shovel
enchants.Heavy Duty: While wearing, you won't take damage ticks from cactus, sweet berries and magma blocks
enchants.Filling: When consumed, grants extra saturation and a few seconds of Strength II and Regeneration I
enchants.Smuggle: Right-click to open, granting 18 slots of extra inventory space that can be filled with chems for running
enchants.Heat Proof: While wearing, grants permanent Fire Resistance
enchants.Lava Walker: Allows the wearer to walk on lava by creating obsidian, similar to Frost Walker
enchants.Medic: While wearing, sneak to grant yourself and nearby players Regeneration II for a few seconds
enchants.Demolitionist: While wearing, the damage you take from explosions is greatly reduced
enchants.High-Velocity: Arrows shot with this bow will travel twice as fast, and twice as far
enchants.Materialize: When killing a player with this item, any Curse of Vanishing items they have will drop instead of vanishing. Increases the odds of your victim's Soulbound I and Soulbound II items dropping
enchants.Aerodynamic: While wearing, and gliding with an elytra, firework rockets will provide a greater boost
enchants.Experience: When mining with this tool, there's a chance that additional EXP will drop from broken blocks
enchants.Froggy Fresh: While wearing, grants permanent Luck, Water Breathing, and Jump Boost II. While wearing, creates froggy fresh particles around you and plays moist sounds when you jump. The luck enchantment does not effect game play
enchants.Phantom Mount: Right-click to summon a skeleton horse mount, or left click to summon a zombie horse mount. While riding the mount, right-click to make yourself and the mount invisible for a few seconds, on a cooldown
enchants.Ghostly: While wearing, grants permanent Invisibility, Speed I, and Jump Boost I. While wearing, creates smoke particles around the wearer
enchants.Sticky: When attacking a player, has a chance to create a cobweb at their feet for a moment
enchants.Peer: While wearing, sneak to highlight nearby players
enchants.Hex: When a player is shot with this, there's a small chance the order of items in their hotbar will be randomized
enchants.Soul Catcher: Plays spooky particle effects and sounds while fishing
enchants.Decaying: Has a chance to catch an extra fish while fishing, but breaks down quicker with use
enchants.Harvester: Grants the Harvester ability, which doubles drops from crops while activated, which can be used in addition to auto-replant. Sneak + right-click to activate ability. Right-click to view charge. Farm crops while holding to recharge.
enchants.Sack: Right-click to open, granting 9 slots of extra inventory space that can be filled with chems for running
enchants.Pilfer: When attacking a player, has a chance to make a random item in their inventory drop onto the ground
enchants.Mining Boost: While mining with this item, there's a chance it will grant a few seconds of Haste II
enchants.Whip: While riding a mount, right-click with this item to give the mount a few seconds of speed boost
enchants.Holiday Magic: Right-click to make all nearby crops (within 10 blocks) instantly grow to maturity
enchants.Lovestruck: When a player is hit with this item, there's a chance that both them and the attacker will get a few seconds of Resistance and Weakness
enchants.Sugar Rush: When consumed, grants a few minutes of Speed II and Jump Boost II
enchants.Stealth I: Hides your name from kill messages
enchants.Featherweight I: Chance to grant a burst of Haste II when attacking
enchants.Synthesize II: Instantly converts chests of chems into compounds. Farm crops while holding to recharge.
enchants.Propel I: Sneak to get a burst of dolphins grace
enchants.Restore I: A one-time replacement if item breaks from durability loss
enchants.Evanescence I: Right-click while riding to make the mount and yourself invisible with speed for a few seconds
enchants.Climbing Boost I: Sneak while climbing for a speed boost
